ABOUT ME & MY PATH

Rooted in statistical foundations. Building for real-world clarity.

Hello, I’m Olajumoke Owoeye (known professionally as Prestige). I am a statistician and AI engineer based in Nigeria.

My journey into AI didn’t start with generative prompts—it started with Demography and Social Statistics at Obafemi Awolowo University. Studying population dynamics, census sampling errors, and regression taught me early on that numbers are never neutral; they represent living human systems, systemic variances, and critical trade-offs.

When I transitioned deeper into machine learning and was selected as one of 30 builders for the TAG Ecosystem AI Engineering Bootcamp, this statistical training became my defining perspective. Rather than treating AI models as black-box magic, I look closely at their evaluation boundaries: testing recall and ranking accuracy in RAG systems, calibrating imbalanced classifiers in fraud detection, and fine-tuning acoustic models for low-resource African dialects on Hugging Face.

Beyond code, I believe in community as an engine for transformation. As Campus Ambassador & Lead for Data Science Nigeria (DSN) OAU, Co-Lead for Google Developer Groups (GDG) on Campus OAU, and a Mentor at AnalystLab Africa, I lead an active community of over 3,000 student technologists. My intentional focus is moving our community from passive learning to active building—breaking the tutorial cycle and empowering students to ship real, verifiable projects.
